verdict.rationale: Maritime has no documented account-wide export, but it does offer pieces that make leaving possible. The Files API can download an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps. Agents are standard Docker images on a simple three-endpoint contract, so workloads stay portable. The CLI and REST API return machine-readable JSON, so agent state can be scripted out. Missing for 10: a one-step export of all account data, documented export of chat/session history, config, triggers and secrets in open formats, documented account exit or deletion, and independent corroboration.
